metaDescription: Check sitemap lastmod values for W3C format, impossible or future dates, missing values and one-date-for-all patterns.
intro: Validates every lastmod in a sitemap and flags suspicious patterns.
why:
Google uses lastmod only when it is consistently accurate. A build script that stamps every URL with the same date teaches crawlers to ignore it.

This tool checks the format (including a time without a zone), real calendar dates and future dates, and it counts distinct days. It cannot tell if a date is true, only if it looks plausible.
howTo: Paste the sitemap XML, or lines of URL and date.

faq.a: W3C datetime: YYYY-MM-DD or a full date and time with Z or +hh:mm.

faq.q: Why is a shared date a problem?
faq.a: It often means the date is generated at build time and not the real change date.

faq.q: Is a future date an error?
faq.a: It is a warning. Dates more than a day ahead are flagged.

faq.q: Does this replace the sitemap validator?
faq.a: No. It focuses on dates; use both.
